description: Retire the shipped .agro/memories/ tier and reconcile its two affected probes and documentation

userStories.title: Remove the memories tier
userStories.description: As an operator, I want .agro/memories/ gone so that the workspace stops advertising a session-start contract that nothing performs.
acceptanceCriteria: Re-check for customization immediately before deletion: git status --porcelain -uall --ignored .agro/memories/ is empty and git diff ab86a8c3 -- .agro/memories/ is empty; stop and report a conflict if either is not
git rm .agro/memories/AGENTS.md .agro/memories/MEMORY.md .agro/memories/SOUL.md .agro/memories/USER.md
git ls-files .agro/memories returns nothing and the directory is absent
No other tracked path under .agro/ is touched by this story

userStories.title: Reconcile the two affected probes
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want both affected probes to match the retirement so that the suite stays green and honest in a source checkout and in an installed project.
acceptanceCriteria: Delete .agro/evals/probes/memories-tier-defaults.sh; every assertion in it is scoped to the retired directory
Rewrite .agro/evals/probes/agents-md-fallback.sh with two universal checks: no tracked CLAUDE.md anywhere, and every tracked AGENTS.md derived from git ls-files is a real file and not a symlink

Keep the root AGENTS.md tracked check, the enumerated directory guides, and the docs/lifecycle-commands.md 2.1.277 floor as source-checkout-only checks, gated on git ls-files --error-unmatch docs/lifecycle-commands.md
The probe prints which mode it ran in and exits 0 in both modes on a correct tree; it does not exit 2 and adds no blanket absent-subject SKIP
Do not name .agro/memories/ anywhere in the probe; the retired guide leaves the set because the set is derived from git, not because a line was deleted
Keep the probe header tier and source lines accurate and keep the CLAUDE.md lesson stated
bash .agro/evals/probes/agents-md-fallback.sh exits 0 in this checkout

userStories.title: Correct layout documentation and the changelog
userStories.description: As a reader, I want the layout map and the release notes to match the tree so that no document advertises a directory that does not exist.
acceptanceCriteria: Update .agro/README.md:14 so the row names logs/ alone
Update docs/oh-directory-layout.md:18 so the row names .agro/logs/ alone, and update the payload sentence at :94 so it no longer names memories as an omitted tree
Remove the two .agro/memories/ ### Added bullets under ## [Unreleased] in CHANGELOG.md; they describe a tier and a probe that no release will contain
Add one ### Removed bullet under ## [Unreleased]: one sentence, imperative, at most 250 characters, linking issue 1116
grep -rIn memories across tracked files returns only historical CHANGELOG lines that describe past releases

userStories.title: Verify in both deployments with negative tests
userStories.description: As the advisor, I want proof in a source checkout and a fresh manifest-installed project so that the reconciled probe is known to fail on a real violation rather than merely to pass.
acceptanceCriteria: Build a fresh manifest-installed project through the real distribution path; record the command used, and justify the fixture explicitly if the real path is unavailable
Run agents-md-fallback.sh in the source checkout and in the installed project; record both actual exit codes and the printed mode
Negative test N1: add a tracked CLAUDE.md; the probe exits 1 in both modes
Negative test N2: replace a tracked AGENTS.md with a symlink; the probe exits 1 in both modes
Negative test N3: remove the 2.1.277 string from docs/lifecycle-commands.md; the probe exits 1 in the source checkout
Positive control: the installed project, which legitimately has no root docs and no .agro/logs/AGENTS.md, exits 0
Every injection is reverted and the tree is proven clean afterwards with git status --porcelain
Record the full-suite baseline before and after and name any failure that predates this change

userStories.title: Complete the gates and deliver the PR
userStories.description: As the operator, I want the audit and eval gates recorded under D-IDs so that acceptance rests on evidence rather than assertion.
acceptanceCriteria: /audit implementation returns a promotable classification
/eval runs once against the final commit and its result is recorded
Knowledge impact derived from the actual diff, not from the prediction
PR body records D1 through D7 evidence, states the upgrade behavior for a fork that customized its copies, and publishes no private content
PR is open with isDraft=false against development on mifunedev/agro, and CI is green for the exact final head SHA verified after the final push and undraft
Skipped and neutral checks reported accurately
